And there was great rejoicing in Antioch.
And in the year 511
[511] of the Arabs, Sultan Ghiyat al-Din Muhammad son of Malik-Shah died in Isfahan,
and his son, Sultan Mahmud, succeeded him.
And in that same year, the Caliph al-Mustazhir died in Baghdad,
and his younger son, al-Mustarshid, succeeded him.
And in this year also,
which is the year 1429
[1429 of the Greeks],
in the month of Ab, Alexios, the king of the Greeks, died,
who was wise and mighty,
and by his wisdom had preserved Constantinople from the Franks.
And his son John reigned after him.
And his brother, his sister, and his mother plotted against him.
And when he had cast his brother and his sister into exile,
and tonsured his mother and made her dwell in a convent,
the kingdom was established for him.
And in that same year died the lord of Egypt.
And the lord of Ghazna also died.
And a little later, Roger, the lord of Antioch, was killed.
Thirteen kings died within two years.
For before they died,
there was a severe earthquake,
and after it followed {OCR?} ... seventeen years, the death of thirteen kings.

When this one became king,
he found many jars of wine belonging to his father,
and he smashed and destroyed them all.
And he drove the female singers and the male singers from the palace.
And he saw his father in a dream saying to him:
"Remove me from beside you,
lest I take you to myself."
And when he was frightened,
he took him out
and buried him in another place.
And he began to show piety.
And he seized the house of Abu Tahir son of Ahmad the treasurer,
and he found in it a church and the whole apparatus of an altar.
